title: The man who poisoned the planet twice
caption:
One man. Two inventions. One very confused atmosphere. ☠️
Leaded petrol stopped engine knock but spread lead everywhere, and CFCs made perfect fridge gas but destroyed ozone high in the sky.
Which invention was worse?
sources: Wikipedia, Thomas Midgley Jr. (tetraethyl lead; 1924 press demonstration; CFCs/Freon; polio in 1940; died 1944 entangled in his pulley device)
J. R. McNeill, Something New Under the Sun (2000): Midgley 'had more impact on the atmosphere than any other single organism in Earth's history'
